title: Histological and histomorphometric study using an ultrasonic crestal sinus grafting procedure. A multicenter case study.*
authors: Wainwright M, Torres-Lagares, D, Pérez-Dorao B, Serrera-Figallo M.A, Gutierrez-Perez J.L, Troedhan, A, Kurrek, A. Med Oral Patol Oral Cir Bucal. 2016; 21(3):e367-73.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “This procedure (Intralift®) allows, using a bovine material with no additional autogenous bone, new bone formation in the sinus in order to allow place implant subantraly. *Study refers to BEGO OSS, which was a private label of cerabone®” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
